name: Fill cancelled appointment slots from a Google Sheets waitlist with Gmail

parameters.content:
## Fill cancelled appointment slots from a Google Sheets waitlist with Gmail

### How it works
Every 15 minutes this workflow offers each cancelled slot to the client who has waited longest for that service and date. If the slot is still free when the claim window ends, it goes to the next person in line.

The client and slot are marked before each email goes out, so nobody gets the same offer twice. An address Gmail rejects leaves the queue so the slot keeps moving. Every email says the slot goes to whoever books first. Staff get a summary of offers, a daily list of rows to fix, and an alert if a scheduled run stops.

### Setup steps
- Connect Google Sheets (OAuth2) and Gmail.
- Add a **Bookings** tab with these headers in row 1: `Booking ID`, `Service`, `Appointment Date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `Appointment Time` (14:30), `Status` (confirmed, cancelled or filled), `Waitlist Offered To`, `Waitlist Offered At`. Add a **Waitlist** tab with: `Waitlist ID`, `Client Name`, `Client Email`, `Service`, `Earliest Date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `Latest Date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `Status` (waiting, offered, booked or send failed), `Added At`, `Offered Slot`, `Offered At`, `Offer Error`.
- In **Set Configuration Params**, fill in your sheet ID, business name, staff email, reply-to email and booking page URL.
- Set your timezone under Workflow settings.
- Run it with `testMode` on, then switch it off.

### Customization
Raise `offersPerRound` in **Set Configuration Params** to fill slots faster, accepting that two people may try to book. Change the wording in **Prepare Slot Offer Email**.

## Schedule and settings

Starts the workflow on a 15-minute schedule, loads configurable values, and checks that required settings are present before any sheet work begins.

## Load sheet data

Reads the spreadsheet as displayed, verifies required columns, and retrieves both bookings and waitlist records for processing.

## Flag rows to fix

Runs a lower branch from the waitlist data to identify malformed or incomplete rows and email staff with cleanup instructions.

## Prepare slot offers

Chooses cancelled slots and matching waitlist clients, then builds the email content needed to offer those appointments.

## Reserve offered rows

Updates the selected waitlist client and appointment slot rows to mark that an offer has been made, preventing duplicate offers.

## Send and record offers

Sends the slot offer email to the client, records the email result, and confirms the waitlist row update in Google Sheets.

## Confirm slot updates

Groups offer outcomes by appointment slot, confirms the affected slot rows in the sheet, and prepares a staff-facing summary.

## Notify staff summary

Sends the final summary email to staff describing the slot offers that were sent.

## Workflow failure alert

A separate bottom error-handling path that triggers on workflow failure, builds an alert, and emails staff that processing stopped.
